# Shipwright Studio

> Shipwright Studio is an independent engineering studio crafting websites, web apps, and AI infrastructure for startups and small teams. Based in the San Francisco Bay Area, working worldwide. Founded and run by a senior software engineer.

## Services

- **Custom website development**: Fast, accessible, search-friendly marketing sites and landing pages. Modern stack, no bloated templates.
- **Web application development**: Interactive dashboards, internal tools, and customer-facing apps — designed, engineered, and deployed end to end.
- **AI infrastructure**: LLM application engineering, inference cost optimization, GPU communication and distributed training performance.

## Selected work

- **Lumen** (https://shipwright-studio.pages.dev/lumen/): An interactive photography lab that teaches the exposure triangle (aperture, shutter speed, ISO) with real-time canvas simulations of depth of field, motion blur, noise, and light metering.
- **Forge** (https://shipwright-studio.pages.dev/forge/): An LLM inference cost estimator. Enter model size, quantization, GPU type, batch size, and traffic to estimate GPU count, latency, and monthly serving cost.
- **The Lab** (https://shipwright-studio.pages.dev/ideas/): An open bank of 66 web experiments — games, developer tools, browser extension prototypes, and small apps. Two new experiments are designed, built, and shipped every day. Recent additions: **Drum Pad** (https://shipwright-studio.pages.dev/lab/drum-pad/), a free online drum pad — tap nine synthesized drum sounds, switch between three kits, and loop a 16-step beat, all in the browser, **Wallet Address Validator** (https://shipwright-studio.pages.dev/lab/address-validator/), a free online wallet address checker — verify an Ethereum address format and its EIP-55 checksum before sending, all computed locally, **Maze Lab** (https://shipwright-studio.pages.dev/lab/maze-lab/), a free online maze generator and solver — generate a perfect maze and watch A* find the shortest path with visited, frontier and path shown step by step, all in the browser, **HTTP Status Guide** (https://shipwright-studio.pages.dev/lab/http-status/), a free online HTTP status code reference — 36 common codes explained in plain English with causes and fixes, live search and class filters, plus a guess-the-code quiz, **Word Counter** (https://shipwright-studio.pages.dev/lab/word-counter/), a free online word counter — paste text to see words, characters, sentences, paragraphs, reading and speaking time and keyword density, all computed locally, **Gas Fee Dashboard** (https://shipwright-studio.pages.dev/lab/gas-tracker/), a free online gas-price board — slow, standard and fast prices across six chains with a congestion meter and transfer and swap cost estimates in dollars, from clearly labelled demo data, **Funding Rate Arbitrage Calc** (https://shipwright-studio.pages.dev/lab/funding-arbitrage/), a free online cash-and-carry calculator — enter spot and perp prices, notional, funding rate and holding period to see funding per interval, daily and annualised funding, fees, breakeven and net P&L, all computed locally, **Game of Life** (https://shipwright-studio.pages.dev/lab/game-of-life/), a free online Conway's Game of Life — paint cells on a 48×32 grid, run Glider, Pulsar and Gosper Glider Gun presets, with speed, wrap-around and randomise controls, all in the browser, **Text Diff** (https://shipwright-studio.pages.dev/lab/text-diff/), a free online text comparison tool — paste original and revised text to see a side-by-side line diff with word-level highlighting, added/removed/changed counts and an ignore-whitespace toggle, all computed locally, **Pocket Piano** (https://shipwright-studio.pages.dev/lab/pocket-piano/), a free online playable piano — two octaves with sustain, multiple voices and computer-keyboard playing, synthesized with WebAudio, all in the browser
